notes.title: Официально: Релиз Unknown 9: Awakening не оправдал ожиданий Bandai Namco, сиквел отменен
notes.content: Продажи игры Unknown 9: Awakening не оправдали ожиданий издательства Bandai Namco Entertainment. Об этом сообщило руководство студии Reflector Entertainment.

notes.title: Action adventure game Unknown 9: Awakening was a 'failure,' says developer, which has cancelled a follow-up project and laid off staff
notes.content: Reflector Entertainment has announced the cancellation of an in-development project and another round of layoffs following the "failure" of its debut game, Unknown 9: Awakening. Studio CEO Herve Hoerdt said he halted work in the project, which was in the "conceptualization phase," as continuing development "would not have been sustainable for the future of the studio.".. Read more.

notes.title: Dive into the making of the Unknown 9 universe with a new trailer
notes.content:
[h2]Take in the scale and depth of the Unknown 9 universe with a new trailer, featuring insightful snippets from interviews of the minds who created or contributed to its creation.[/h2]

From talented actress [b]Anya Chalotra[/b] who portrays [b]Haroona[/b] in the video game [i]Unknown 9 Awakening[/i], to the many talents involved in the making of the [b]podcast, comic books, web series and novels[/b], this trailer goes behind the scenes and into the creations of each product of the [i]Unknown 9[/i] universe.

And today this universe expands further with the release of the third and final novel of the [b]Genesis Trilogy by Layton Green:[/b] [i]Ascension[/i]. This last novel brings a conclusion to the story of Andie, a brilliant young woman whose mentor mysteriously disappears, leaving her with a trail of clues that will lead her around the world and in the crossfire of feuding secret societies.

notes.title: Создатели Unknown 9: Awakening уволили 18% персонала, в разработке находятся два проекта
notes.content: По студии Reflector Entertainment прокатилась волна сокращений. Она затронула порядка 18% персонала. Согласно официальному заявлению руководства, студия якобы переходит на новый этап развития. При этом были уволены люди, не задействованные в текущих проектах.

notes.title: Unknown 9: Awakening studio makes major layoffs just a month after the game's release
notes.content: month after the release of its debut game Unknown 9: Awakening, Bandai Namco-owned Reflector Entertainment has announced that it is laying off 18% of its workforce so it can "efficiently deliver on our most pressing objectives while guaranteeing that every member of our team can meaningfully contribute to our ongoing projects.".. Read more.

notes.title: Опоздать на 20 лет: Обзор Unknown 9: Awakening
notes.content: Мечта сделать свою Uncharted продолжает будоражить умы инди-разработчиков и топ-менеджеров крупных компаний. Японское издательство Bandai Namco и канадская студия Reflector Entertainment, состоящая из ветеранов Ubisoft, решили создать целую трансмедийную вселенную Unknown 9, в которую входят не только игры, но также книги, комиксы, подкасты и сериалы. В итоге им удалось создать клон игры от Naughty Dog, но крайне посредственный по исполнению и образца 2007 года.

notes.title: Unknown 9: Awakening (Xbox Series X) Review
notes.content:
To say I have been excited for Unknown 9: Awakening would be an understatement. From seeing the trailer back in March to checking it out at Summer Game Fest and then finally going hands-on with U9A at PAX this year, I have been dying to get my hands on the full release. I am happy to say that Unknown 9: Awakening truly satisfied all of my needs regarding a fresh take on combat and a captivating story.

Unknown 9: Awakening truly managed to pull me into its story, leaving me invested in the characters involved. Many games have tried this, but only a few have really captured me in the way that Unknown 9: Awakening has. U9A follows Haroona, a young girl who finds herself with a power she doesn’t quite understand. Haroona is voiced and motion captured by The Witcher’s Anya Chalotra, and after speaking with her about the game, I can see how much her performance meant to her, putting a spotlight on her Indian background and playing a female lead in an excellent video game. notes.title: Unknown 9: Awakening feels like a AA videogame from the late 2000s, and so far that isn't a bad thing
notes.content: Those who love linear, narrative-driven, set-piece laden videogames might wish time had paused in 2013 (and don't we all, for lots of reasons). The era dominated by the Xbox 360 was a good time for people who like to play rollercoaster videogames with frequent QTEs, barely interactive but beautiful worlds, and fat-free twelve hour runtimes. From the Tomb Raider reboot through to deep cuts like Neverdead, big publishers don't release many games in this style anymore (and when they do they tend to regret it)... Read more.

notes.title: Step into Unknown 9: Awakening’s Gameplay Trailer 🎬
notes.content:
[h3]You play as Haroona, a fierce truth-seeker (what we call a “[i]Quaestor[/i]”) with a unique connection to another dimension known as the Fold. This other plane of existence contains powerful energy and long-lost knowledge that, if brought to light, could usher us into a wondrous era of advancement. However, if this forgotten wisdom falls into the wrong hands, it could lead to our inevitable demise.    [/h3]

[previewyoutube=dBE4VV-PuIE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This quest will have you uncover the long-lost secrets of our collective past. Haroona will also learn to tap into the Fold’s energy, gifting her incredible skills, known as Umbric abilities, that allow her to take down anyone who stands in her way.

The gameplay shows Haroona Crushing, Pushing, and Pulling people and objects from a distance, and mysteriously Shielding herself from enemy fire. She also Steps into her opponents to take control of their minds, bodies, and weapons. These are just a few of the Umbric abilities you’ll use when you play the game. The closer we get to its release, the more of these skills we’ll reveal. 

Players looking to switch up their playstyle will be able to play in stealth, combat, and Umbric abilities mode. Each style has its advantages, but it’s the combination of the three that will provide you with the versatility needed to overcome whatever enemies cross your path. [/h3]

[h2][url=https://bnent.eu/U9Awakening]Believe in the Unknown. Learn more here.[/url][/h2]
